commands.command: this is a tragic story where i wandered in circles until my health reached zero. despite the repetitive movement, i was never able to find any additional food sources after consuming the dry root early on. the blue gourd was explicitly stated as not to be eaten, and no other edible items appeared in any of the locations i visited. my actions consisted of moving between the hall, store, larder, and yard, repeatedly examining objects like the blue gourd and stone slabs, but finding nothing useful. the lack of additional food sources and my deteriorating health led to an inevitable end.
